nodes.label: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.rationale: Records the shipped 0.1.0-alpha feature set and explicitly warns that repository completeness is not live Quattro certification.

nodes.label: Arcana Interpretation Research and Specification
nodes.rationale: Defines the approved interpretation, provenance, safety, deterministic-composition, and agent-handoff contracts while distinguishing verified facts from then-proposed implementation.

nodes.label: Arcana README
nodes.rationale: Describes the current standalone Omarchy Quattro plugin, user controls, trust boundary, persistence, rendering behavior, and validation commands.

nodes.label: Arcana Quickshell Plugin Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Defines the staged architecture, security gates, implementation tasks, tests, risks, and release acceptance criteria for version 0.1.

nodes.label: Major Arcana Guide
nodes.rationale: Authors a system-metaphor lens for all 22 Major Arcana while retaining traditional archetypal roles.

nodes.label: Minor Arcana Guide
nodes.rationale: Maps the four Minor Arcana suits and rank progression into the Sovereign Desktop vocabulary.

nodes.label: Arcana Visual Grammar
nodes.rationale: Specifies the card frame, sigil, typography, palette, illustration language, symbolic translation, and pilot-card tests.

nodes.label: Arcana
nodes.rationale: Arcana is explicitly a standalone Omarchy Quattro/Quickshell plugin using a complete original 78-card deck as a keyboard-first reflective system.

nodes.label: Arcana 0.1.0-alpha
nodes.rationale: The changelog calls this the first complete alpha candidate and enumerates implemented runtime, rendering, interaction, and validation capabilities.

nodes.label: Keyboard-first reflective system
nodes.rationale: The product frames tarot as local symbolic reflection rather than prophecy, diagnosis, advice, or factual authority.

nodes.label: Complete 78-card runtime deck
nodes.rationale: The alpha exposes 78 cropped illustration plates, a reversible card back, and live resolution-independent card chrome.

nodes.label: Daily, free, and Context / Friction / Doorway draws
nodes.rationale: These are the three user-facing draw modes; daily selection is stable by local date and the three-card spread draws without replacement.
nodes.norm_label: daily, free, and context / friction / doorway draws

nodes.label: XDG-local bounded state
nodes.rationale: State is limited to current daily selection, last reading, draw counter, and local preferences at the documented XDG state path.

nodes.label: Layered theme-responsive card renderer
nodes.rationale: Structural black and ivory remain fixed while packaged primary, secondary, and fault masks map to Arcana or live Quattro semantic colors with deterministic low-contrast fallback.

nodes.label: Sparse fault-mask contract
nodes.rationale: Nine cards intentionally contain fault pixels; all other images carry transparent fault layers so the three-mask renderer remains uniform and validator-enforced.

nodes.label: Face-down reveal and inspection interaction
nodes.rationale: New draws begin face-down, support independent mouse or keyboard flips, defer interpretation until the final reveal, and provide a bounded responsive inspection lightbox.

nodes.label: Ask Your Agent handoff
nodes.rationale: The feature previews a bounded reading packet and requires explicit launch through Omarchy's configured default agent; agent prose remains optional and non-canonical.

nodes.label: Arcana trust boundary
nodes.rationale: The plugin excludes arbitrary files, history, environment dumps, vault content, credentials, and unrelated state, and sends only the current reading plus an optional delimited question.

nodes.label: Live Quattro certification boundary
nodes.rationale: Repository completeness is not evidence of live Quattro certification; the dedicated VM release report and screenshots define the tested boundary.

nodes.label: Constrained interpretive synthesis
nodes.rationale: Chosen to allow several plausible readings without rigid fortune-telling or unlimited association; every synthesis remains deterministic, local, inspectable, and evidence-constrained.

nodes.label: Reading as structured symbolic hypothesis
nodes.rationale: A reading is expressly not a factual finding; reflective and conditional phrasing preserves uncertainty and agency.

nodes.label: Seven-layer source precedence
nodes.rationale: Observed deck artwork outranks historical RWS anchors, consensus, conventions, Omarchy translation, composer hypotheses, and optional agent prose so no layer silently overwrites another.

nodes.label: Atomic provenance-aware semantic model
nodes.rationale: Small claims with IDs, lenses, provenance kinds, source references, and normalized themes replace a single undifferentiated meaning blob.

nodes.label: Provenance kinds
nodes.rationale: The schema distinguishes source quotation, original paraphrase, deck observation, Omarchy original, structural convention, composer inference, and agent-assisted content.

nodes.label: Position-conditioned meaning
nodes.rationale: A spread position asks a semantic question of a card rather than assigning moral polarity.

nodes.label: Context / Friction / Doorway spread
nodes.rationale: Context names the organizing condition, Friction names pressure or blocked capacity, and Doorway names a resource, experiment, boundary, or inquiry, with only declared pair relations.

nodes.label: Typed reversal policy
nodes.rationale: Reversals use none, traditional, energy-state, or multi-hypothesis policies and card-specific modes rather than generic opposition or automatic negativity.

nodes.label: Energy-state reversal
nodes.rationale: The recommended default chooses a supported reversal mode by stable precedence: direct claim, position fit, adjacent relation, repeated theme, then claim-ID tie-break.

nodes.label: Optional elemental dignities
nodes.rationale: Disabled by default; when enabled, elemental relations change salience rather than good/bad valence.

nodes.label: Court person / role / approach modes
nodes.rationale: Court cards are interpreted through rank by suit while excluding required gender, age, appearance, or family hierarchy.

nodes.label: Agency-preserving question reframing
nodes.rationale: Questions are normalized toward open, neutral, user-centered inquiry while the original remains visible; yes/no, should, timing-only, and third-party mind-reading forms are discouraged.

nodes.label: Deterministic composer
nodes.rationale: The composer validates inputs, transforms claims by position and orientation, adds only supported layout relations and patterns, selects anchors stably, and emits evidence IDs without network or model calls.

nodes.label: Primary and evidence-backed alternative readings
nodes.rationale: The composer emits one strongest reading and at most one materially different alternative along a named ambiguity axis, plus an observable distinguishing question.

nodes.label: Reflective language and safety policy
nodes.rationale: Conditional phrases are required while certainty, supernatural verification, diagnosis, guaranteed timing, crisis directives, catastrophe predictions, and private-thought claims are forbidden.

nodes.label: Originality and editorial policy
nodes.rationale: Modern prose is research context rather than redistributable copy; all 78 runtime records require concise original wording, provenance, artwork inspection, and editorial acceptance.

nodes.label: Bounded agent handoff contract
nodes.rationale: The exact UTF-8 packet is previewed, control-normalized, bounded to a recommended 12 KiB, transported as one argv element, and limited to the immutable current reading snapshot.

nodes.label: Agent power disclosure
nodes.rationale: Explicit confirmation and disclosure are required because Omarchy agents may run commands or change files in unattended modes; advisory wording is not a sandbox.

nodes.label: Non-canonical agent result boundary
nodes.rationale: Version 0.1 neither ingests nor canonizes terminal output; any future returned text must be explicit, removable, untrusted, and separately labeled agent-assisted.

nodes.label: A. E. Waite — The Pictorial Key to the Tarot
nodes.rationale: Used as the attributed public-domain Rider–Waite–Smith historical anchor for descriptions, meanings, reversals, and a Celtic Cross method.
nodes.norm_label: a. e. waite — the pictorial key to the tarot

nodes.label: Joan Bunning tarot lessons
nodes.rationale: Supplies the principal composition model: personal response, accumulated meaning, position, circumstances, position pairs, reversals, and story synthesis.

nodes.label: Golden Dawn Book T
nodes.rationale: Used as historical evidence for elemental and court/pip correspondences, not as proof of an exhaustive universal formula.

nodes.label: Mary K. Greer on elemental dignities
nodes.rationale: Supports treating elemental dignity as strength or attention rather than moral classification.
nodes.norm_label: mary k. greer on elemental dignities

nodes.label: Rachel Pollack — Tarot Is Story
nodes.rationale: Supports image-driven story and possibility rather than isolated doctrine.

nodes.label: TABI ethics code
nodes.rationale: Supports autonomy, honesty, confidentiality, referral, protection of minors, and reframing of third-party questions.

nodes.label: Tarosophy Code
nodes.rationale: Supports informed expectations, consent, confidentiality, professional scope, and secure record handling.

nodes.label: Verified Omarchy agent contract
nodes.rationale: Source inspection establishes the configured-agent getter, prompted launch wrapper, picker routes, terminal ownership, and absence of a canonical default-agent environment variable.

nodes.label: Marketplace baseline evidence
nodes.rationale: The representative argv launch passed the inspected baseline, but the specification explicitly treats this as design evidence rather than proof for an exact future release tree.

nodes.label: Quattro plugin architecture
nodes.rationale: One repository exposes a bar-widget and headless QML service; BarWidget owns a nested Panel while the service centralizes state, randomness, persistence, and monitor synchronization.

nodes.label: Shared Arcana service
nodes.rationale: A single global service prevents multi-monitor duplicate draws and owns stable reading state while panel presentation stays lazy.

nodes.label: Frozen plugin identity
nodes.rationale: Repository, manifest, installed directory, module, and summon target are all fixed around org.ministryoftaste.arcana to prevent identity drift.

nodes.label: Marketplace-compatible security posture
nodes.rationale: The plan excludes direct network access, privilege, install hooks, runtime helpers, system services, symlinks, binaries, and ambient data capture.

nodes.label: Bounded /dev/urandom entropy
nodes.rationale: A direct argv Process invokes od over /dev/urandom and feeds Fisher–Yates; shell use and silent Math.random fallback are prohibited.

nodes.label: Stable daily-card invariant
nodes.rationale: Daily card and orientation persist for the local date across open, reload, and restart, with explicit confirmation for redraw.

nodes.label: Free-draw isolation and no replacement
nodes.rationale: Free draws do not replace daily state and a spread cannot contain duplicate cards, though repeats across readings are allowed.

nodes.label: Versioned XDG state model
nodes.rationale: State is written atomically outside the checkout, validated fail-closed, bounded by count, and preserves explicit preferences.

nodes.label: Lazy bounded image rendering
nodes.rationale: Only the back, visible card, and adjacent spread cards decode; hidden UI halts timers, transitions, and image work to constrain shell resource use.

nodes.label: Test-gated staged delivery
nodes.rationale: The 14-task plan requires tests-first pure logic, exact Quattro contract inspection, VM-only interactive QA, exact-tree security review, and fresh-clone publication verification.

nodes.label: Exact-tree release review
nodes.rationale: The reviewed commit must be frozen; any later edit invalidates Marketplace and live validation gates and requires rerunning them.

nodes.label: Designated Omarchy testbed VM
nodes.rationale: Interactive restarts, focus tests, input, agent launch, screenshots, and resource checks are intentionally isolated from the personal workstation.

nodes.label: Sovereign Desktop
nodes.rationale: The desktop becomes a symbolic environment where windows are thresholds, terminal is will, configuration is ritual, and system cycles form a tarot journey.

nodes.label: Traditional archetype plus system lens
nodes.rationale: System titles explicitly add a second lens rather than replacing traditional tarot meaning.

nodes.label: The Fool / First Boot
nodes.rationale: Beginning and experimental entry into unconfigured possibility.

nodes.label: The Magician / The Operator
nodes.rationale: Focused will translating intention into executable command.

nodes.label: The High Priestess / Hidden Config
nodes.rationale: Intuition and inspection beneath visible interface state.

nodes.label: The Empress / Generative System
nodes.rationale: Cultivation of conditions where useful work continues to emerge.

nodes.label: The Emperor / Window Rules
nodes.rationale: Protective structure and boundaries without obsolete rigidity.

nodes.label: The Hierophant / Established Workflow
nodes.rationale: Documented inherited practice examined before alteration.

nodes.label: The Lovers / Alignment
nodes.rationale: Coherent integration grounded in explicit shared truth.

nodes.label: The Chariot / Keyboard Momentum
nodes.rationale: Disciplined acceleration after opposing forces are aligned.

nodes.label: Strength / Controlled Power
nodes.rationale: Patient governance of powerful processes without destroying usefulness.

nodes.label: The Hermit / Focus Mode
nodes.rationale: Reduction of environmental noise until essential signal becomes visible.

nodes.label: Wheel of Fortune / Update Cycle
nodes.rationale: Recurrence and change managed through recoverability.

nodes.label: Justice / Permissions
nodes.rationale: Authorization balanced with accountability and consequence.

nodes.label: The Hanged Man / Suspended Process
nodes.rationale: Productive pause and altered perspective rather than endless stalling.

nodes.label: Death / Terminate–Restart
nodes.rationale: Ending an incoherent state so a new session can initialize.

nodes.label: Temperance / Integration
nodes.rationale: Calibrated interface where distinct sources preserve necessary character.

nodes.label: The Devil / Dependency Loop
nodes.rationale: Distinguishing structural bindings from unexamined retained constraints.

nodes.label: The Tower / System Failure
nodes.rationale: Fault-driven revelation of architecture hidden by normal operation.

nodes.label: The Star / Recovery State
nodes.rationale: Restoration of shared network and material foundation after disruption.

nodes.label: The Moon / Hidden Processes
nodes.rationale: Tracing uncertainty without hardening first explanations into belief.

nodes.label: The Sun / Coherent System
nodes.rationale: Legible vitality where tools and purpose become clear.

nodes.label: Judgement / System Call
nodes.rationale: Reckoning with which dormant processes should return changed.

nodes.label: The World / Complete Environment
nodes.rationale: Completion through integration of parts, operator, and purpose.

nodes.label: Three-State Diagnostic spread
nodes.rationale: Uses active state, hidden dependency, and next command as a three-position systems diagnostic.

nodes.label: Failure and Recovery spread
nodes.rationale: Moves from stable appearance and fault line through termination, recovery, and new architecture.

nodes.label: Sovereign Desktop spread
nodes.rationale: Organizes operator, tool, daemon, rule, hidden configuration, and environment into a six-position whole.

nodes.label: Minor Arcana as Sovereign Desktop activity
nodes.rationale: The suits describe activity inside the symbolic desktop while preserving traditional elemental roles.
nodes.norm_label: minor arcana as sovereign desktop activity

nodes.label: Wands / Execution / Fire
nodes.rationale: Maps command, ignition, building, automation, ambition, and directed will to Fire.

nodes.label: Cups / Connection / Water
nodes.rationale: Maps emotion, communication, memory, intuition, imagination, and shared signal to Water.

nodes.label: Swords / Logic / Air
nodes.rationale: Maps thought, debugging, conflict, language, permission, analysis, and cutting truth to Air.

nodes.label: Pentacles / Material System / Earth
nodes.rationale: Maps body, hardware, files, packages, money, resources, craft, and maintenance to Earth.

nodes.label: Cross-suit rank progression
nodes.rationale: Ace through Ten move from potential through completion and excess, while Page learns, Knight moves, Queen internalizes and sustains, and King directs and governs.

nodes.label: Order surrounding mystery
nodes.rationale: The deterministic frame signifies system order while the central illustration carries archetypal mystery.

nodes.label: Locked archival card format
nodes.rationale: Specifies a 1200×2100 RGB 4:7 canvas, 1032×1548 illustration viewport, paired graphite frames, semantic divider, and deterministic header/footer.

nodes.label: Cursor-sigil
nodes.rationale: A command line, diamond focus boundary, semantic node, registration stem, and brass terminal point form the shared mark; four equal panes are prohibited to avoid Windows-logo resemblance.

nodes.label: Deterministic typographic hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Serif numerals and card names remain primary, monospaced system metadata secondary, and generated art contains no lettering.

nodes.label: Canonical Arcana palette
nodes.rationale: Base, ivory, muted, focus cyan, brass, and fault orange define a deliberately low-saturation system with sparse accents.

nodes.label: Engineered symbolic illustration language
nodes.rationale: Charcoal texture, ivory geometry, technical lines, restrained bloom, operator-like figures, and strong silhouettes replace generic cyberpunk clichés.

nodes.label: Desktop references as symbols
nodes.rationale: Desktop motifs must function archetypally—planes as architecture, cursors as will, panes as thresholds, and suit objects as system instruments—rather than as literal props or screenshots.

nodes.label: Approved visual-grammar test cards
nodes.rationale: The Magician tests command and four instruments, the Hermit tests negative space and quiet illumination, and the Tower tests catastrophic rupture within engineered geometry.

nodes.label: Seven-card visual grammar pilot
nodes.rationale: The Fool, High Priestess, Death, and Temperance extend the approved three to test initiation, secrecy, transformation, and synthesis.
